job.title: GM - Business Development
job.description:
What's in it for you?

This is a refreshing opportunity...as you're not joining a start-up searching for scale...you're starting with it.

Part of a major Australasian group, this substantial organisation operates at the intersection of healthcare, retail, pharmacy, technology and consumer services. Think major national footprint, established brands and channels, significant customer reach, rich healthcare relationships, digital and data capability - and the investment capacity to turn great opportunities into something meaningful.

The core business is established, successful and is continuously growing. Now comes the exciting part: leveraging that platform to create what's next.
New services. New markets. New partnerships. New business models. New revenue streams.

Reporting directly to the CEO and joining the Executive Leadership Team, you'll have the mandate to look beyond the traditional core business, identify where the organisation should play next - and then make it happen.

The opportunity:

This is not a traditional strategy role. We're looking for a commercial growth leader and dealmaker - someone who can see an opportunity, determine its commercial viability, find the right partner and negotiate the deal over the line. You'll leverage the organisation's customers, channels, brands, data, digital capabilities and healthcare relationships to unlock entirely new avenues for growth.

More specifically, you'll:
  • Identify and build a pipeline of high-value growth opportunities and healthcare adjacencies.
  • Explore new markets, services, business models and revenue streams.
  • Originate, structure and negotiate significant strategic partnerships and commercial agreements.
  • Identify potential new ventures, investments and acquisition opportunities.
  • Find the right partners and get the right people around the table.
  • Work alongside specialist M&A, finance and legal teams to take opportunities from concept through to execution.
  • Turn great opportunities into revenue, earnings and enterprise value.
About you:
  • You're commercially curious, entrepreneurial and naturally external. You build networks, open doors and make things happen.
  • Just as importantly, you'll thrive in a culture that values people who are humble, hungry and smart - ambitious without the ego, commercially sharp, curious and naturally collaborative.
You'll bring:
  • Senior experience across strategic partnerships, business development, corporate development, new ventures and/or commercial growth.
  • A track record of personally originating and landing significant partnerships, ventures and/or deals.
  • Evidence of creating new revenue streams, entering new markets and/or developing new business models.
  • Strong commercial and financial judgement.
  • The credibility to influence and negotiate at CEO, Executive and Board level.
  • The ability to navigate a large organisation while maintaining an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Energy, curiosity and a genuine appetite to be out in the market, creating opportunities and getting deals over the line.
Experience across healthcare, pharmaceuticals, pharmacy, diagnostics, medical services or health technology will be highly regarded. However, exceptional commercial growth leaders from consumer, retail, technology or other sophisticated service environments will also be considered.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply ASAP  or if you have questions, contact Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity via gabbys@peopleequity.com.au or 0432 261 116.

job.title: Product Development Manager
job.description:
Why This Role?
This high-growth, national organisation is already a clear leader in the electrical products space—built on a reputation for doing things differently. Rather than reselling other people's products, they design and own their private label ranges, solving real customer problems and raising the bar with every release. Now, they require an experienced Product Development Manager to take full ownership of their core product range, and its development end to end. 

The Opportunity
Reporting to the GM and supported by a Product Coordinator, you'll lead the private label Product Development function—with a clear focus on managing and continuously improving the core range. You'll work hands-on with manufacturers across China as well as engineers and technical specialists to turn ideas into commercially successful products then work internally to project manage them through to launch. This is a role where you won't design products yourself, rather you’ll own the process: concept, supplier collaboration, prototyping, compliance, manufacturing, launch and continuous improvement—start to finish.

What we are looking for
You get a buzz from solving problems, sweat the details, and take real pride in owning a process end to end—not just one piece of it. You also have:
  • Proven end-to-end Product Development experience, from concept to commercialisation.
  • Experience developing electrical related products where product testing, certification and regulatory compliance have been key.
  • Hands-on experience working with manufacturers across China.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
  • A commercially minded, hands-on approach and genuine curiosity.
Highly regarded experience includes:
  • Fire and life safety products
  • Industrial or engineered products
  • Consumer electronics, hardware or appliances
A qualification in Engineering, Product Design, Industrial Design, Manufacturing (or similar) will be highly regarded, however we're equally interested in experienced Product Development professionals who've built their expertise through hands-on industry experience.

Please apply ASAP or for any direct questions, please reach out to Gabby Symons, MD, People Equity at gabbys@peopleequity.com.au and 0432 261 116.

You're already an accomplished Store Manager (or above) from a big box or large-format retail environment, and you've built your reputation by growing both the business and the people around you.

  • Experience running a serious retail operation—a large team, significant turnover, demanding customers and plenty of moving parts.

  • A leadership style people naturally follow. You're visible, approachable, decisive and never afraid to roll up your sleeves alongside your team.

Success is achieved in the Private Label division through the application of superior sourcing, product development, trading and planning practices and the ability to translate trends and develop products to the needs of their customers.  A career opportunity now presents for an experienced Product Manager – Private Label to conceptualise, develop and deliver exclusive new products that will capitalise on market and ranging opportunities and in turn deliver strong sales and margin growth. job.description:
Key Points:
  • Heavy hitting, ‘customer obsessed’ world class ‘big box’ retailer
  • Lead, engage & empower your team to delight your customers every day in everyway
  • Make your ultimate career move - reward & recognition is waiting for you
What's in it for you?
  • An awesome roster: that includes one Saturday a fortnight, and every alternate weekend off
  • The privilege: to be in a role and part of an organisation that will invest in you and your development FULLY, from the day you start and ongoing. With such an extensive induction program and period, you will have the opportunity to learn the business across every aspect (and likely across multiple stores) before you officially step into the role. You will literally be set up for success from Day 1!
  • The culture: Its vibrant, customer obsessed, 'down to earth', authentic, welcoming and inclusive and it values its most important asset, ‘its people.’
  • The trust: to develop, inspire, lead and empower the store team to greater levels of excellence so they become the best version of themselves every day in every way
  • A role where you are expected to have fun and to celebrate all the wins: this is a non-negotiable!
  • Its growth focused: The appetite is strong for further business expansion and growth. In fact the store will relocated in July this year to a location that will double in size! Be a part of a continued success story
  • An extraordinary role: that will take your career experience to a whole new level as well as build your profile right across the broader organisation and store network
  • Rewards: The package is generous & includes many benefits inc a car, super and bonus. It’s set to attract and retain the markets best
Your prospective employer:
  
If you've been looking for a "home" in your career - a place where you feel connected to the values of the organisation and supported to wholeheartedly invest in the development of your people - then please read on.  This award-winning “big box” national retailer is constantly transforming its store network to enable an agile response to the evolving needs of its customer in a fast moving product category.  It's a place where people are valued, developed, inspired and engaged every day.  As the Store Manager you will lead and create a culture within your store that feels like "home" to you, your team and your customers.  It will be a place where your people feel supported, nurtured and motivated to create the most innovative and memorable customer experiences.  As a retailer, they pride themselves on operating with 'family values' because they see their customers and community as extensions on their family to make a difference in the way they do business every day.

  • Be a valued brand ambassador and the ‘face’ of your store
  • Develop relationships in the local community and build on the untapped commercial sales opportunities

  • You are recognised as a talented and experienced ‘big box/large format’ Store Manager (or level above) where you have led and inspired large teams and high-volume stores to success
  • Have demonstrated success and passion for engaging and developing a team of high performers 
  • You have well-honed operational skills across inventory planning and management, as well as shrewd financial control.
  • You drive sales with an upbeat approach and have a natural ability to engage
  • Have well-honed operational skills across inventory planning and management, and shrewd financial control
